name: smwgraphics-drill-dozer-kuru-ruins
title: Drill Dozer - Kuru Ruins
description:
A set of backgrounds from the first Kuru Ruins stage in Drill Dozer. It makes a nice addition to any ruins related area.
Included is;
Map16Page.bin - The Map16 page for the backgrounds, insert to any blank Map16 page.
KuruRuins.bin - The ExGFX file!
KuruRuinsOutside.mwl - A sample level for the outside background.
KuruRuinsInside.mwl - A sample level for the inside background.
ScreenShots.zip - Screenshots of both BG's from Lunar Magic's background editing window.

No credit needed. PM me with any major flaws.
